description: This file implements a React component for managing attachments within the Notesnook app, including features like filtering, rechecking attachment integrity, downloading, and UI rendering.

classes.name: RecheckerProgress
classes.description: Tracks progress of attachment rechecking process including failed and passed counts, working state, visibility, and filter type.

classes.name: RecheckerState
classes.description: State management for attachment rechecking, including progress per note and current filter.

methods.name: AttachmentDialog
methods.description: Main React component for managing and displaying attachments, with filtering, rechecking, and download functionalities.

methods.name: AllProgress
methods.description: Component displaying ongoing download/upload progress for attachments related to a note.

methods.name: AttachmentDialog.present
methods.description: Function to present the attachment management sheet/modal for a specific note.
